conform.notes: Cached copy of Bangkok Metropolitan Administration's ArcGIS layer เลขที่บ้าน (House Number), HID/Survey_Basemap MapServer layer 0 (see website), pulled 2026-09 and converted to GeoJSON (2,091,357 features). The live service is too slow to page through within a batch job (~30-90s per 1,000-record page, ~2 days for a full pull), so it is cached instead. Building-footprint layer linked to house-number records: ~77% of records have BL_HOUSENUM, ~66% have BL_ROAD or BL_SOI (~58% both); BL_POSTCODE/BL_DISTRICT are filled in virtually every row. BL_ADDRESS and BL_SUB_DISTRICT are kept in the cached file for future use. Many unmatched rows carry a placeholder BLDG_ID of 0 with no house number (footprints not yet linked to a house record) and are skipped for lacking number/street.
